audience: WordPress site owners and agencies who host sites on servers managed with SpinupWP

useCases.title: Check the health of servers and sites
useCases.text: The AI lists servers with connection status, disk space and reboot or upgrade flags, and sites with PHP version, HTTPS and pending WordPress updates.

useCases.title: Review recent activity and failed events
useCases.text: The AI lists recent events such as deploys, restarts and cache purges with status and who started them, and reads one event's output.

useCases.title: Look up domains and redirects of a site
useCases.text: The AI lists the additional domains of a site with their redirect settings, and its path redirects.

useCases.title: Purge the cache of a site
useCases.text: The AI purges the page cache or the Redis object cache of one site. The call returns an event id, so the AI can check when it is done.

useCases.title: Deploy a site from git
useCases.text: The AI pulls the latest commit of a site's connected git branch and runs its deploy script. This changes the live site, and the event shows when it is done.

useCases.title: Restart a service or reboot a server
useCases.text: The AI restarts nginx, PHP or MySQL on one server, or reboots the whole server. Visitors may notice a short break.
